name: insightface_r50_wf600k
source: InsightFace model-zoo pack buffalo_l: https://github.com/deepinsight/insightface/releases/download/model-zoo/buffalo_l.zip (288,621,354 B, sha256 80ffe37d8a5940d59a7384c201a2a38d4741f2f3c51eef46ebb28218a7b0ca2f, downloaded 2026-10-11), member w600k_r50.onnx (174,383,860 B) extracted unmodified. params.input: ArcFace norm_crop 112x112, RGB, (x-127.5)/127.5, NCHW float32 (insightface ArcFaceONNX: no Sub/Mul in the first graph nodes -> mean=std=127.5, swapRB on BGR input = RGB)
params.runtime: ONNX Runtime CUDA EP, fp32 weights/activations (CUDA EP default use_tf32=1 for convs), dynamic batch (input 'input.1' [None,3,112,112]; output declared [1,512] but follows the batch)
params.backbone: IResNet-50 (43.6M parameters in the ONNX initializers), 512-d
params.train_data: WebFace600K (InsightFace naming; the ~0.6M-identity WebFace12M identity set, see docs/INSIGHTFACE_SURVEY.md)
params.published: insightface model_zoo/README.md 'Recognition accuracy of python library model packs', row buffalo_l: MR-ALL 91.25, African 90.29, Caucasian 94.70, South Asian 93.16, East Asian 74.96, LFW 99.83, CFP-FP 99.33, AgeDB-30 98.23, IJB-C(E4) 97.25
